aut_theorem.method: colour refinement proved equivariant for an arbitrary finite graph (aut_of_certificate, no native_decide); concrete facts class_v0 (3 rounds: class of vertex 0 = its 32 images) and dM_id (vertex 0 individualised, 4 rounds: discrete) by native_decide
